title: RescueSpeech: A German Corpus for Speech Recognition in Search and Rescue Domain
production_type: primary spontaneous/task speech in simulated search-and-rescue exercises
manual_evidence: Zenodo v2 explicitly describes manually annotated recordings; corpus paper reports all 2412 clean utterances manually transcribed
available_primary_data: clean ASR speech archive plus speech-enhancement derivative archive; authoritative Zenodo objects retained rather than committing large audio
notes: Core eligibility applies to clean human recordings and their manual transcripts. Synthetic/noise-contaminated speech-enhancement derivatives are lineage-linked but excluded as independent production observations. Archive-level transcript extraction remains pending because the public archive is large.
